lines.text: Hallelujah!
I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart
in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
Great are the works of the LORD;
they are pondered by all who delight in them.
Splendid and majestic is His work;
His righteousness endures forever.
He has caused His wonders to be remembered;
the LORD is gracious and compassionate.
He provides food for those who fear Him;
He remembers His covenant forever.
He has shown His people the power of His works
by giving them the inheritance of the nations.
The works of His hands are truth and justice;
all His precepts are trustworthy.
They are upheld forever and ever,
enacted in truth and uprightness.
He has sent redemption to His people;
He has ordained His covenant forever;
holy and awesome is His name.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom;
all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding.
His praise endures forever!

pictures.scene: Ambrogio Lorenzetti, Allegory of Good Government — the angel of Justice weighing out to each his own, the works of His hands are truth and justice
pictures.name: pd_lorenzetti_giustizia

pictures.scene: Caravaggio, Saint Jerome Writing — the old man bent over the open book, setting down precepts that are trustworthy
pictures.name: pd_caravaggio_jerome

pictures.scene: Diego Velázquez, Christ Crucified — He has sent redemption to His people
pictures.name: pd_velazquez_cristo

pictures.scene: El Greco, The Adoration of the Name of Jesus — heaven and earth bowing before the Name, holy and awesome is His name
pictures.name: pd_greco_nombre

pictures.scene: Gentile da Fabriano, Adoration of the Magi — the eldest king kneeling with his crown laid on the ground, the fear of the LORD the beginning of wisdom
pictures.name: pd_fabriano_magi

pictures.scene: Titian, La Gloria — Christ enthroned in heaven with the company of the blessed, His praise enduring forever
